title: The Lord's Foresight: Every Operation Prepared Before Its Crisis
description: A second "beforehand" chain extending to ongoing redemption: the Third Ambassador called before night and day are separated; the ships of light adorned for the ascent of light through the Zone; the Judge throned in the living air before Sin reigns in the flesh; Christ the Apostle appointed before Error's manifestation; stars and spheres fitted to coming generations; releasers given a sign before the cosmos's release; and the Great Builder summoned to adorn the new Aeon.
